description: Search nodes by text, node_type, and/or semantic `type`. Token-AND across title + description + tags. Primary retrieval path — use it before reading bodies. Results are ranked best match first — `score` on each row is the match strength (title hits count double). Page 1 is the top of the ranking. A one-word query can match hundreds of rows — put two or more terms in `query` so the top rows are the answer, not a dump. Terms are AND-ed: if two return nothing, drop one. Reports total_matches; when more matches exist than fit in one response, narrow the query or pass { cursor } for the next page (a cursor is only valid for the query that produced it).
name: vpshardening__search_nodes
